notablePrerequisites:
Hell's Caretaker does not have summoning sickness.
It is your upkeep step.
description:
During your upkeep, activate Teardrop Kami by sacrificing it, targeting Hell's Caretaker.
When Teardrop Kami dies, Ogre Slumlord triggers, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Teardrop Kami trigger, untapping Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping it and sacrificing the Rat, returning Teardrop Kami from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
